notes.title: 2.25Update announcement
notes.content:
Dear friends, how are you? We are pleased to announce an update patch today. Patch to open the achievements of the system, we have added a total of nearly 30 achievements, each achievement icon is that we call the calligrapher personally written, I hope you like the achievements of Chinese calligraphy.
We also fix some BUG, ​​which will greatly enhance your gaming experience, the rest of the known BUG will be repaired in the recent patch, which we apologize.
We will immediately open the pool card system, is expected in a few days on the line. Hope that we look forward to. Thank you.

2.25 days
